'''Drell''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Drell disliked unsecured [[Computer/Legends|computer]] links and opening up a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] operating system to outside links.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
